title: tt_export line
description: One line of a Twisted Tongues project export. The file is UTF-8 ndjson: the first non-empty line matches $defs/header, every other non-empty line matches $defs/document, and a file a server signed ends with one $defs/signature. Readers should ignore lines and fields they do not recognize; fields may be added without a version bump, while any change a strict reader of this schema would reject bumps `version`. See docs/design/save-load-snapshot.md.

exported_at.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch, at export time. Optional.

project_id.description: The project this file came from. Written by a server export; absent from a file the browser wrote, which has no id to give.

update_seq.description: An opaque cursor for the moment this snapshot was read. Hand it back to a change feed and nothing between the two is missed. Server exports only.

collection.description: meta holds project-level documents such as track templates; passages and sentences hold the linguistic data. A sentence's id is prefixed by its passage's id.

internal.description: The app's own document state, 1:1 with its database, and the only thing the app reads on import. Its shape is deliberately UNSPECIFIED: it may change without a version bump and may drift toward `doc` over time. Nothing outside the app may depend on it — everything meant for reading is in `doc`.

id.description: Document id, unique within its collection. Sentence ids are '<passage id>-<10-digit counter>'.

rev.description: Opaque revision token of the source database at export time. Comparable for equality only; carries no ordering or structure.

creator.description: Opaque user id: unverified approximate provenance, not identity the system vouches for.

imported.description: Present when this document arrived in its project via a file import. creator/modifier upstream of an import are file-supplied and unverifiable.

at.description: Import time, seconds since the Unix epoch.

by.description: Opaque user id of the importer.

rev.description: Opaque revision token of the doc in the database it was imported from.

data.description: The external view of the document's payload: every string NFD-normalized Unicode, with per-collection shapes below. Every field the writer emits here is documented in this schema — undocumented internal fields live only in `internal` until deliberately promoted. Derived at export and ignored on import — a hand-edited `data` never enters a database.

type.description: As shown in the app's template UI. T2IPA tracks are entered as TIPA notation and displayed as IPA; in this external view their values are already the display form, so most readers never need this field.

track_template.description: The id of the meta template this passage was created from — the join key to the meta collection's template documents.

words.description: One object per word: track name -> NFD display value.

sentences.description: Sentence-level track values, keyed by track name — e.g. this sentence's English translation and its French translation.

grammatical.description: The grammaticality judgment for this sentence.

infelicitous.description: The felicity judgment for this sentence.

metaData.description: Project-level documents. Track templates carry kind/name/tracks; a meta document of no known kind exports an empty data shell (its content is in `internal` only).

signature.description: The last line of a signed file, vouching for every byte above it. Written by a server that holds a signing key; a file the browser wrote has none, and an unsigned file is perfectly valid. Verifying needs only the public key named by `kid`.

alg.description: The construction. `Ed25519-SHA256` means: SHA-256 over every byte above this line, then Ed25519 over the canonical JSON of {alg, kid, project_id, exported_at, sha256} prefixed with "tt_export_sig.v1\n". The claims are signed too, so `alg` and `kid` cannot be rewritten on a file that still verifies.

kid.description: Which public key verifies this, so keys can rotate without old files becoming unverifiable.

exported_at.description: Epoch seconds, fractional — the same value the header carries.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of every byte above this line.

sig.description: base64url, unpadded, of the Ed25519 signature.
